name: asia-countries-service
description:
## Asian Countries Service
Manages Asian countries data. Public API: `countries`, `isLoading`, `hasError`, `getAsiaCountries`.

variables.name: isLoading
variables.description: Indicates if the API request is in progress.

variables.name: hasError
variables.description: Indicates if an error occurred during the fetch.

variables.name: getAsiaCountries
variables.description: Fetches the list of Asian countries from the GraphQL API.
